# WhatsApp Business API Integration Project

This workspace is configured for developing a WhatsApp Business API integration using Meta's Cloud API.

## Project Structure
- Node.js/Express server for webhook handling
- WhatsApp Business API integration
- Business verification and setup utilities
- Environment configuration management
- Message handling and response logic

## Development Guidelines
- Use environment variables for sensitive API keys
- Implement proper webhook verification
- Follow WhatsApp Business API best practices
- Include comprehensive error handling
- Add logging for debugging webhook events

## Key Components
- Webhook endpoint for receiving WhatsApp messages
- Message processing and response logic
- Business profile setup and verification
- Media handling capabilities
- Template message management
